title: The Sum Released on an Accepted Keyturn Host Protection Plan Claim
content:
Money accepted on a claim under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan reaches the host through their payout account, and the desk releases it against the claim it belongs to.

### What is released

The money released is the whole of what stands owed to the host on the enrolment, with nothing set against it for what the host owes, nothing withheld, and no share taken for the standing of the enrolment, the state of the vehicle's repair or an earlier payment; it is rounded half up to two decimal places once, on the final result, and the payment is never less than nothing.

### The numbers each plan publishes

| Plan | Claims allowed before review | Claims allowed before suspension |
|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 2 | 4 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 2 | 4 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 3 | 5 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 3 | 5 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 4 | 6 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 5 | 8 |

Every figure the plan publishes, the numbers of claims it allows before review and before suspension among them, is read from the plan the enrolment is written on.

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

An enrolment on which 3150 stands owed to the host releases 3150.00, the rounding half up to two decimal places being done once on that final result. An enrolment on which nothing stands owed releases nothing, the payment never falling below nothing.
